subject: Customer receiving duplicate order confirmations on NetLink terminal
description: Multiple customers reported receiving two order confirmations for single online orders placed today. Issue started around 2 PM. RTR-0046-01 appears to be sending duplicate submissions to the system. Need urgent fix to prevent billing issues.
resolution_notes: Order gateway timeout settings adjusted on RTR-0046-01. Double-submission prevention filter enabled. Verified with test orders—duplicates no longer appearing. Cache cleared and system restarted.
